استأهلا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْهَلَا (istaʔhalā) /is.taʔ.ha.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
# اِسْتَأْهِلَا (istaʔhilā) /is.taʔ.hi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَأْهَلَ (istaʔhala)
